title: Ulyana and the Hymn
author: Felix Lockridge
blurb: Gideon Underhill, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
